item.title: U.S. withdraws from military exercises with South Korea set for next month
item.description: The move comes as the Iran war strains U.S. military resources in Asia.

item.title: Pence says U.S.-Canada trade fight adds to affordability concerns for economy
item.description: “I think the last thing we need right now, as our economy is getting back on its feet, is a trade war with Canada,” the former vice president told CNN.
